description:
Sr. Core Java Developer with strong Database development skills 
 All 8 positions are developers - A combination of database / core Java development . The focus is on Core Java (they will not work with any front end development of frameworks), Teradata, Oracle, and Unix Programming. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Responsibilities will vary based on the specific project each consultants is assigned to. Some of the general responsibilities will include 
 1. Developing Java services to process dataservice requests to different Java based applications.
 2. Write complex SQL queries and Shell scripts as part of daily activities.
 3. Analyze issues and suggest technical solutions. 
 Must Haves: 
 Strong Oracle Development Experience: 
 Needs to understand the use of triggers 
 Needs to have DDL Scripting experience 
 Needs to understand the use of internal & external tables 
 Needs to understand all aggregate functions in Oracle 
 Needs to understand how to work with Views 
 Needs to understand the different types of sub-quarries 
 Needs to understand the different types of table partitions . 
 Strong Teradata Development Experience: 
 Must have experience using Load/Unload Utilities BTEQ, Teradata SQL Assistant, Tpump, FastLoad, MultiLoad, FastExport 
 Needs to understand the different types of Indexes- advantages/dis-advantages of each. 
 Needs to understand stored procedures- How to utilize them 
 Needs to understand how to create views in tables 
 Needs to understand bulk inserts
 Strong Unix Scripting and Programming Experience: 
 Must have strong Shell Scripting/Programming, knowledge specific commands, working with command lines 
 Must have experience accessing the command line arguments from the Shell Scripts 
 Must have experience debugging Schell scripts 
 Must have experience working with hard links and soft links?
 Core Java Development Experience: 
 Experience with Multi-threading and synchronization, 
 Must have experience with Abstract Classes and interfaces 
 Must have experience with Strings and Arrays 
 Must have experience with OOPs Concepts & Patterns 
 Must understand File IO and Serialization 
 Must have experience with Collections - List , Map , Set etc. 
 Must have experience with Exceptions - Checked , Unchecked
 Nice to haves: 
 Knowledge of Data warehousing concept 
 Knowledge of Data modeling
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
